title: Wolstenholme Primes and the Mod 4 Open Question
description: Formalizes Wolstenholme primes (primes p where C(2p-1,p-1) ≡ 1 mod p⁴). Proves computationally that primes 5-23 are NOT Wolstenholme primes. Axiomatizes the two known Wolstenholme primes (16843 and 2124679, both ≡ 3 mod 4). Proves structural results and formalizes the open question: does any Wolstenholme prime exist with p ≡ 1 mod 4? 3 axioms.

overview.historicalContext: Wolstenholme's theorem (1862): C(2p-1,p-1) ≡ 1 mod p³ for p ≥ 5. Only two Wolstenholme primes (satisfying mod p⁴) are known.
overview.problemStatement: Define Wolstenholme primes and prove properties of the two known examples.
overview.proofStrategy: Compute C(2p-1,p-1) mod p⁴ for small primes to verify non-Wolstenholme; axiomatize large known examples.
